description:
Build one product's reference as a complete prompt: ordered screens with notes, observed
transitions, links to up to 10 agent-sized images (1x copies and section crops, each with its
pixel size), the measured design guide and an implementation checklist; the same prompt as
the site's "Use in agent" button. referenceId is `{product}-onboarding` (its flow),
`{product}-collection` (everything) or one screen id. To combine screens from several
products, use build_recipe.

goal.description: What you want to build. Goes at the top of the prompt.

includeDesign.description: Include the observed design guide. Set false to use your project's own design system.

screens.description: Comma-separated screen ids to keep. Omit to include every screen in the reference.

stack.description: Preferred stack, e.g. Next.js and Tailwind.

name: build_handoff
title: Build an agent handoff prompt
